faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026 is 30 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for various posts including Project Associate-I, Senior Project Associate, Project Scientist-I, and Project Scientist-II in the CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts are Project Associate -I, Senior Project Associate, Project Scientist -I, and Project Scientist -II. These positions are project-based and focus on research activities.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for CSIR CSMCRI Recruitment 2026 is entirely through email. Candidates need to send their complete application and documents to the specified email addresses.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/PwBD/Women (5 years) and OBC (3 years).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: For Project Associate-I, the salary is ₹31,000 + HRA for NET/GATE/DST Inspire qualified candidates, and ₹25,000 + HRA for others, per month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the qualifications required for Project Scientist-I?
faq.answer: For Project Scientist-I, candidates need a Doctoral Degree in Chemical Science or Chemistry/Physical Sciences with 4 years of relevant experience in R&D in industrial or academic institutions.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for CSIR CSMCRI posts?
faq.answer: The job location for these positions is Bhavnagar, Gujarat, with pincode 364002. CSIR CSMCRI is located in this city.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their applications and documents, followed by an interview, which may be conducted in online or offline mode.
